name: Savage Frontier
title: Savage Frontier: The Cold Frontier
description: The Savage Frontier is a vast and dangerous land of rugged hills, dense forests, and untamed monsters, situated between the Sword Coast and the desert of Anauroch.
wiki: Life in the Savage Frontier is a constant struggle against the elements and the various tribes of orcs, trolls, and giants that call the region home. It contains isolated settlements and ruins of ancient empires like Delzoun and Netheril.

popup.title: Triboar
